layouts.prompt_zh: 电商单品主图。核心任务：第一眼看清商品。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品与用户资料总结图片受众}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据商品资料总结}。文案：{由用户提供资料或者根据商品自行推断设计}。商品主体：{由用户指定、参考图识别或商品资料提取}。必须保留的商品识别信息：{由根据参考图或资料总结；如无特殊要求则留空}。其余画面表现请围绕“主体清晰、商品突出、第一眼看懂商品”完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。
layouts.prompt_en: E-commerce single product hero image. Core task: Clearly present the product at first glance. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product and user data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on product data}. Copy: {Provided by user materials or inferred and designed based on the product}. Product subject: {Specified by user, recognized from reference image, or extracted from product data}. Mandatory product identification features: {Summarized based on reference image or data; leave blank if no special requirements}. Render the rest of the visual presentation around "clear subject, prominent product, immediately understandable at first glance". Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

layouts.name: 多角度展示图
layouts.prompt_zh: 电商多角度展示图。核心任务：让用户快速看清商品整体结构与不同视角。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品与用户资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据商品资料总结}。文案：{由用户提供资料或者根据商品自行推断设计}。商品主体：{由用户指定、参考图识别或商品资料提取}。需要重点展示的角度或结构：{由用户指定；若未指定，由根据商品形态判断最有信息价值的视角}。其余多视角组织方式与画面表现请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。
layouts.prompt_en: E-commerce multi-angle display image. Core task: Allow users to quickly see the overall product structure and different perspectives. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product and user data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on product data}. Copy: {Provided by user materials or inferred and designed based on the product}. Product subject: {Specified by user, recognized from reference image, or extracted from product data}. Angles or structures to emphasize: {Specified by user; if unspecified, determine the most informative angles based on product morphology}. Autonomously arrange the multi-angle composition and visual presentation. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

layouts.name: 细节特写图
layouts.prompt_zh: 电商细节特写图。核心任务：突出商品最值得关注的局部细节、做工或质感。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品与用户资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据商品资料总结}。文案：{由用户提供资料或者根据商品自行推断设计}。商品主体：{由用户指定、参考图识别或商品资料提取}。重点细节：{由用户指定；若未指定，由根据商品资料提炼最值得展示的真实细节}。其余特写视角、取景、光线与质感表现请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。
layouts.prompt_en: E-commerce detail closeup image. Core task: Highlight the product's most notable local details, craftsmanship, or material texture. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product and user data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on product data}. Copy: {Provided by user materials or inferred and designed based on the product}. Product subject: {Specified by user, recognized from reference image, or extracted from product data}. Key details: {Specified by user; if unspecified, extract the most valuable authentic details based on product data}. Autonomously determine the closeup angles, framing, lighting, and texture rendering. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

layouts.name: 包装 / 套装 / 内容物展示图
layouts.prompt_zh: 电商包装、套装与内容物展示图。核心任务：让用户快速看清购买后实际获得的商品、包装、配件或组合内容。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品与用户资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据商品资料总结}。文案：{由用户提供资料或者根据商品自行推断设计}。商品与内容物：{从用户输入、商品清单或参考资料中提取，不得补造不存在的配件或赠品}。其余陈列方式、层级关系与视觉组织请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。
layouts.prompt_en: E-commerce packaging, set, and contents display image. Core task: Let users quickly see what is actually included upon purchase—products, packaging, accessories, or bundled items. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product and user data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on product data}. Copy: {Provided by user materials or inferred and designed based on the product}. Product and contents: {Extracted from user input, product list, or reference data; do not invent non-existent accessories or gifts}. Autonomously arrange display composition, hierarchical relations, and visual layout. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

layouts.name: 卖点标注图
layouts.prompt_zh: 电商卖点标注图。核心任务：快速传达商品最重要的购买理由。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品与用户资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据商品资料总结}。文案：{由用户提供资料或者根据商品自行推断设计}。商品主体：{由用户指定、参考图识别或商品资料提取}。核心卖点：{优先使用用户提供内容；若未明确，从商品资料中提炼 3～5 个真实卖点}。卖点优先级：{由根据目标受众与购买决策价值排序}。其余标注方式、视觉层级与画面表现请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。
layouts.prompt_en: E-commerce feature callout image. Core task: Quickly communicate the most compelling reasons to buy. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product and user data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on product data}. Copy: {Provided by user materials or inferred and designed based on the product}. Product subject: {Specified by user, recognized from reference image, or extracted from product data}. Core selling points: {Prioritize user-provided content; if not specified, extract 3-5 authentic selling points from product data}. Priority of selling points: {Rank based on target audience and purchase decision value}. Autonomously determine annotation methods, visual hierarchy, and overall presentation. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

layouts.name: 功能演示图
layouts.prompt_zh: 电商功能演示图。核心任务：直观表现商品能做什么，以及核心功能如何作用。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品与用户资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据商品资料总结}。文案：{由用户提供资料或者根据商品自行推断设计}。商品主体：{由用户指定、参考图识别或商品资料提取}。核心功能：{从用户输入或商品资料提取}。功能作用对象与结果：{仅根据可确认资料总结，不得虚构效果}。其余动作设计、状态表现、功能可视化方式与画面表现请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。
layouts.prompt_en: E-commerce function demonstration image. Core task: Intuitively demonstrate what the product does and how its core functions operate. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product and user data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on product data}. Copy: {Provided by user materials or inferred and designed based on the product}. Product subject: {Specified by user, recognized from reference image, or extracted from product data}. Core function: {Extracted from user input or product data}. Function target and result: {Summarized strictly from verifiable data, do not fabricate effects}. Autonomously design the action, state representation, function visualization method, and overall visual presentation. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

layouts.name: 参数尺寸图
layouts.prompt_zh: 电商参数尺寸图。核心任务：让用户快速理解影响购买决策的关键规格与尺寸。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品与用户资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据商品资料总结}。文案：{由用户提供资料或者根据商品自行推断设计}。商品主体：{由用户指定、参考图识别或商品资料提取}。关键参数：{从用户资料中提取真实的尺寸、容量、重量、规格等；没有资料时不得猜测}。参数优先级：{由根据商品类别与购买决策价值筛选}。其余测量关系、信息组织与视觉表达请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。
layouts.prompt_en: E-commerce specification and dimension image. Core task: Let users quickly understand critical specifications and dimensions that influence buying decisions. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product and user data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on product data}. Copy: {Provided by user materials or inferred and designed based on the product}. Product subject: {Specified by user, recognized from reference image, or extracted from product data}. Key specifications: {Extract genuine dimensions, capacity, weight, specs, etc., from user data; do not guess if data is missing}. Specification priority: {Filter based on product category and purchase decision value}. Autonomously design measurement relations, information layout, and visual presentation. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

layouts.name: 材质 / 结构解析图
layouts.prompt_zh: 电商材质与结构解析图。核心任务：解释商品由什么构成，以及材质、结构或组成为什么重要。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品与用户资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据商品资料总结}。文案：{由用户提供资料或者根据商品自行推断设计}。商品主体：{由用户指定、参考图识别或商品资料提取}。材质、组成或结构信息：{从用户输入或商品资料中提取；可根据商品类型自动理解为配方、面料、部件、层级、内部结构等}。其余剖面、分层、局部放大、爆炸展开等视觉表达方式请自主选择。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。
layouts.prompt_en: E-commerce material and structure analysis image. Core task: Explain what the product is made of, and why its materials, structure, or composition matter. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product and user data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on product data}. Copy: {Provided by user materials or inferred and designed based on the product}. Product subject: {Specified by user, recognized from reference image, or extracted from product data}. Material, composition, or structural information: {Extracted from user input or product data; interpret appropriately as ingredients, fabrics, components, layers, or internal structure depending on product type}. Autonomously select visual techniques such as cross-sections, exploded views, layering, or callout blowups. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

layouts.name: 生活方式场景图
layouts.prompt_zh: 电商生活方式场景图。核心任务：让用户自然想象拥有和使用商品后的生活状态。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品定位与资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据商品资料与受众总结}。文案：{由用户提供资料或者根据商品自行推断设计}。商品主体：{由用户指定、参考图识别或商品资料提取}。生活情境：{若用户已指定则使用；否则由根据商品用途、受众和品牌调性概括最合适的生活情境}。其余人物、环境、时间、光线、道具和氛围请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。
layouts.prompt_en: E-commerce lifestyle scenario image. Core task: Enable users to naturally envision their lifestyle after owning and using the product. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product positioning and data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on product data and audience}. Copy: {Provided by user materials or inferred and designed based on the product}. Product subject: {Specified by user, recognized from reference image, or extracted from product data}. Lifestyle setting: {Use if specified by user; otherwise summarize the most suitable setting based on product use, audience, and brand tone}. Autonomously design the characters, environment, time of day, lighting, props, and overall atmosphere. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

layouts.name: 人物使用图
layouts.prompt_zh: 电商人物使用图。核心任务：清晰展示人与商品之间的真实使用关系。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品定位与资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据商品资料总结}。文案：{由用户提供资料或者根据商品自行推断设计}。商品主体：{由用户指定、参考图识别或商品资料提取}。使用者：{由用户指定；未指定时由根据目标受众概括}。使用动作：{由用户指定，或根据商品真实用途总结}。其余人物姿态、镜头、场景和交互表现请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。
layouts.prompt_en: E-commerce in-use demonstration image. Core task: Clearly showcase the genuine usage relationship between user and product. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product positioning and data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on product data}. Copy: {Provided by user materials or inferred and designed based on the product}. Product subject: {Specified by user, recognized from reference image, or extracted from product data}. User persona: {Specified by user; if unspecified, summarize based on target audience}. Usage action: {Specified by user, or summarized based on genuine product usage}. Autonomously design character pose, camera framing, scene setting, and interactive expression. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

layouts.name: 多场景适用图
layouts.prompt_zh: 电商多场景适用图。核心任务：展示同一商品在多个典型场景中的适用性。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品定位与资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据商品资料总结}。文案：{由用户提供资料或者根据商品自行推断设计}。商品主体：{由用户指定、参考图识别或商品资料提取}。主要使用场景：{优先使用用户提供场景；未提供时由根据商品用途和目标受众总结 3～5 个最典型场景}。其余场景组织、画面节奏与统一视觉表现请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。
layouts.prompt_en: E-commerce multi-scenario application image. Core task: Showcase the versatility and applicability of the same product across multiple representative scenarios. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product positioning and data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on product data}. Copy: {Provided by user materials or inferred and designed based on the product}. Product subject: {Specified by user, recognized from reference image, or extracted from product data}. Key usage scenarios: {Prioritize user-provided scenarios; if not provided, summarize 3-5 typical scenarios based on product utility and target audience}. Autonomously determine scene arrangement, visual rhythm, and cohesive presentation. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

layouts.name: 使用步骤 / 教程图
layouts.prompt_zh: 电商使用步骤或教程图。核心任务：让用户快速理解商品如何正确使用。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品与用户资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据商品资料总结}。文案：{由用户提供资料或者根据商品自行推断设计}。商品主体：{由用户指定、参考图识别或商品资料提取}。使用步骤：{从用户说明、说明书或商品资料中提取并整理为清晰顺序；不得编造关键操作}。注意事项：{仅提取有依据的信息}。其余步骤画面、动作视角与流程组织请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。
layouts.prompt_en: E-commerce usage steps or tutorial image. Core task: Allow users to quickly grasp how to use the product properly. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product and user data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on product data}. Copy: {Provided by user materials or inferred and designed based on the product}. Product subject: {Specified by user, recognized from reference image, or extracted from product data}. Usage steps: {Extract from user instructions, manuals, or product data into a clear sequence; do not fabricate key actions}. Precautions: {Extract only verifiable information}. Autonomously design step illustrations, action perspectives, and workflow layout. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

layouts.name: 对比优势图
layouts.prompt_zh: 电商对比优势图。核心任务：让用户快速理解本商品与其他方案之间的关键差异。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品与用户资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据商品资料总结}。文案：{由用户提供资料或者根据商品自行推断设计}。本商品：{由用户指定、参考图识别或商品资料提取}。对比对象：{由用户指定；未指定时只能基于用户资料中已有的对比对象进行总结，不得虚构竞品信息}。比较维度：{从资料中提取真实差异，并根据购买决策价值排序}。其余对比结构与视觉表达请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。
layouts.prompt_en: E-commerce comparative advantage image. Core task: Allow users to quickly understand key differentiators between this product and alternative options. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product and user data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on product data}. Copy: {Provided by user materials or inferred and designed based on the product}. This product: {Specified by user, recognized from reference image, or extracted from product data}. Comparison target: {Specified by user; if unspecified, summarize only from existing comparison targets in user data, do not fabricate competitor info}. Comparison criteria: {Extract genuine differences from data and rank by purchase decision value}. Autonomously design comparison layout structure and visual expression. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

layouts.name: 型号 / SKU 差异图
layouts.prompt_zh: 电商型号与 SKU 差异图。核心任务：帮助用户快速区分不同颜色、尺寸、容量、配置或型号。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品与用户资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据商品资料总结}。文案：{由用户提供资料或者根据商品自行推断设计}。SKU / 型号列表：{从用户资料中提取}。各版本主要差异：{由根据真实资料整理，不得推测不存在的区别}。其余版本陈列、分组与信息层级请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。
layouts.prompt_en: E-commerce model and SKU comparison image. Core task: Help users quickly distinguish between different colors, sizes, capacities, configurations, or models. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product and user data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on product data}. Copy: {Provided by user materials or inferred and designed based on the product}. SKU / model list: {Extracted from user data}. Key differences between versions: {Organized based on authentic data; do not infer non-existent differences}. Autonomously arrange version showcase, grouping, and information hierarchy. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

layouts.name: 适配 / 选择指南图
layouts.prompt_zh: 电商适配与选择指南图。核心任务：帮助用户判断哪一种商品、规格或版本最适合自己。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品定位与资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据商品资料总结}。文案：{由用户提供资料或者根据商品自行推断设计}。用户条件：{由用户输入，或根据目标受众总结常见选择条件}。选择维度：{从真实资料中提取，如尺码、容量、设备、使用场景、需求等}。推荐关系：{根据用户资料中的规则整理；无依据时不得自行建立硬性推荐关系}。其余选择路径与视觉表达请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。
layouts.prompt_en: E-commerce fit and selection guide image. Core task: Help users determine which product, specification, or edition best suits their needs. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product positioning and data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on product data}. Copy: {Provided by user materials or inferred and designed based on the product}. User conditions: {Input by user, or summarized based on common conditions of target audience}. Selection dimensions: {Extracted from genuine data, such as sizing, capacity, compatible devices, usage scenarios, needs, etc.}. Recommendation logic: {Organized based on rules in user data; do not establish rigid recommendations without evidence}. Autonomously design selection pathways and visual representation. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

layouts.name: FAQ / 注意事项图
layouts.prompt_zh: 电商 FAQ 与注意事项图。核心任务：集中解决购买前最重要的疑问、限制条件与注意事项。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品与用户资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据商品资料总结}。文案：{由用户提供资料或者根据商品自行推断设计}。问题与答案：{优先使用用户提供内容；未提供时只能根据已有商品资料整理可确认的问题与答案，不得虚构政策、承诺或功能}。重点注意事项：{从资料中提取}。其余信息分组与视觉表达请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。
layouts.prompt_en: E-commerce FAQ and precautions image. Core task: Centrally address the most crucial pre-purchase questions, constraints, and precautions. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product and user data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on product data}. Copy: {Provided by user materials or inferred and designed based on the product}. Q&A content: {Prioritize user-provided content; if not provided, compile only verifiable questions and answers from existing product data; do not fabricate policies, promises, or features}. Key precautions: {Extracted from data}. Autonomously organize information grouping and visual layout. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

layouts.name: 品质 / 工艺说明图
layouts.prompt_zh: 电商品质与工艺说明图。核心任务：通过真实工艺、制造过程或品质细节建立价值感。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品与用户资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据商品资料总结}。文案：{由用户提供资料或者根据商品自行推断设计}。商品主体：{由用户指定、参考图识别或商品资料提取}。品质与工艺信息：{从用户资料中提取并整理为最有说服力的真实信息}。其余工艺呈现方式、细节表现与画面组织请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。
layouts.prompt_en: E-commerce quality and craftsmanship explanatory image. Core task: Establish a sense of value through authentic craftsmanship, manufacturing processes, or quality details. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product and user data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on product data}. Copy: {Provided by user materials or inferred and designed based on the product}. Product subject: {Specified by user, recognized from reference image, or extracted from product data}. Quality and craftsmanship information: {Extracted from user data and organized into the most persuasive authentic information}. Autonomously design the craftsmanship presentation, detail rendering, and visual arrangement. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

layouts.name: 认证 / 数据证明图
layouts.prompt_zh: 电商认证与数据证明图。核心任务：用可验证的认证、检测结果、性能数据或实验信息建立可信度。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品与用户资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据商品资料总结}。文案：{由用户提供资料或者根据商品自行推断设计}。认证 / 数据：{仅从用户资料或明确来源中提取；没有可确认资料时必须留空或提示用户补充，不得生成虚假认证、数值或实验结论}。重点结论：{基于真实资料压缩总结}。其余数据视觉化方式请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。
layouts.prompt_en: E-commerce certification and data proof image. Core task: Build credibility using verifiable certifications, test results, performance metrics, or experimental data. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product and user data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on product data}. Copy: {Provided by user materials or inferred and designed based on the product}. Certification / data: {Extracted solely from user data or clear sources; leave blank or prompt user if unverifiable, never fabricate certifications, numbers, or lab findings}. Key conclusion: {Compressed summary based on authentic data}. Autonomously determine data visualization methods. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

layouts.name: 评价 / 口碑图
layouts.prompt_zh: 电商评价与口碑图。核心任务：通过真实用户反馈建立社会证明。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品与用户资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据商品资料总结}。文案：{由用户提供资料或者根据商品自行推断设计}。评价内容：{仅使用用户提供的真实评价、平台资料或明确可用的口碑信息，不得虚构用户名、评分、销量或评价}。口碑关键词：{从真实评价中提炼}。其余评价呈现形式与视觉表达请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。
layouts.prompt_en: E-commerce review and word-of-mouth image. Core task: Establish social proof through authentic customer feedback. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product and user data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on product data}. Copy: {Provided by user materials or inferred and designed based on the product}. Review content: {Use only genuine user reviews, platform data, or verified reputation data; do not fabricate usernames, ratings, sales counts, or reviews}. Reputation keywords: {Extracted from authentic reviews}. Autonomously determine review presentation formats and visual styling. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

layouts.name: 品牌 / 来源故事图
layouts.prompt_zh: 电商品牌与来源故事图。核心任务：帮助用户理解商品背后的品牌、来源、设计理念或制造背景。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品与品牌资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据品牌与商品资料总结}。文案：{由用户提供资料或者根据商品自行推断设计}。品牌 / 来源信息：{从用户资料、品牌资料或商品背景中提取}。故事重点：{筛选最有助于理解商品价值的真实内容}。其余叙事画面与视觉表达请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。
layouts.prompt_en: E-commerce brand and origin story image. Core task: Help users understand the brand, origin, design philosophy, or production background behind the product. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product and brand data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on brand and product data}. Copy: {Provided by user materials or inferred and designed based on the product}. Brand / origin information: {Extracted from user data, brand assets, or product background}. Story focus: {Select authentic content that best communicates product value}. Autonomously design narrative visuals and artistic presentation. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

layouts.name: 新品上市图
layouts.prompt_zh: 电商新品上市图。核心任务：明确传达“这是一个值得关注的新商品 / 新版本”。受众：{由用户输入，或根据新品定位与资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据新品资料总结}。文案：{由用户提供资料或者根据商品自行推断设计}。新品主体：{由用户指定、参考图识别或商品资料提取}。新品亮点：{由用户提供，或从新品资料中提炼真实变化与核心价值}。发布时间、上市信息：{仅在用户资料明确提供时使用}。其余发布感、视觉冲击与画面表现请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。
layouts.prompt_en: E-commerce new arrival launch image. Core task: Clearly communicate that "this is a noteworthy new product / new release". Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on new release positioning and data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on new release data}. Copy: {Provided by user materials or inferred and designed based on the product}. New product subject: {Specified by user, recognized from reference image, or extracted from product data}. Product highlights: {Provided by user, or extracted as authentic changes and core values from new release data}. Launch date / release info: {Use only when explicitly provided in user data}. Autonomously design the launch energy, visual impact, and graphic presentation. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

layouts.name: 促销活动图
layouts.prompt_zh: 电商促销活动图。核心任务：让用户快速理解活动利益点并产生即时购买动机。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品和活动资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据活动资料总结}。文案：{由用户提供资料或者根据商品自行推断设计}。商品主体：{由用户指定、参考图识别或商品资料提取}。活动机制：{从用户资料中提取折扣、满减、赠品、组合、限时等真实活动信息}。活动时间与限制：{仅使用用户明确提供的信息}。其余促销氛围、视觉重点和画面表现请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。
layouts.prompt_en: E-commerce promotion and sales event image. Core task: Enable users to immediately grasp promotional benefits and generate purchase intent. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product and campaign data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on campaign data}. Copy: {Provided by user materials or inferred and designed based on the product}. Product subject: {Specified by user, recognized from reference image, or extracted from product data}. Campaign mechanics: {Extract genuine discount, tiered reduction, gifts, bundles, or limited-time campaign rules from user data}. Campaign dates and limits: {Use only explicitly provided user info}. Autonomously design promotional atmosphere, focal points, and visual presentation. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

layouts.name: 内容种草 / UGC 图
layouts.prompt_zh: 电商内容种草与 UGC 图。核心任务：用更自然、更像真实分享的方式传达商品体验与推荐理由。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品与平台资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据商品资料总结}。文案：{由用户提供资料或者根据商品自行推断设计}。商品主体：{由用户指定、参考图识别或商品资料提取}。使用体验与推荐理由：{优先使用用户提供内容；若无真实体验资料，只能基于商品已知特征总结，不得冒充真实消费者评价}。平台语境：{由用户指定；未指定时可由根据任务判断}。其余随拍感、生活感、镜头和视觉表达请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。
layouts.prompt_en: E-commerce content seeding and UGC image. Core task: Convey product experience and recommendation reasons in a natural, organic sharing style. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product and platform data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on product data}. Copy: {Provided by user materials or inferred and designed based on the product}. Product subject: {Specified by user, recognized from reference image, or extracted from product data}. Experience and recommendation rationale: {Prioritize user-provided content; if absent, summarize based on known product traits without faking customer testimonials}. Platform context: {Specified by user; if unspecified, infer based on task}. Autonomously design the casual snap aesthetic, everyday realism, camera angles, and visual expression. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

layouts.name: 广告主视觉 / Hero / KV
layouts.prompt_zh: 电商广告主视觉、Hero 或 KV。核心任务：围绕商品建立一个强烈、集中、具有传播力的核心视觉概念。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品、品牌与传播资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据商品与传播目标总结}。文案：{由用户提供资料或者根据商品自行推断设计}。商品主体：{由用户指定、参考图识别或商品资料提取}。核心传播信息：{由用户提供，或根据商品卖点、品牌定位和传播目标提炼}。创意方向：{用户指定时优先；未指定时请根据商品属性和核心传播信息自主选择，如超现实、微缩世界、巨型商品、概念隐喻、艺术装置、流体世界、悬浮视觉、材质世界、编辑式广告等}。除事实信息与核心传播信息外，其余视觉创意请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。
layouts.prompt_en: E-commerce key visual, hero shot, or key art (KV). Core task: Build an intense, focused, highly communicable core visual concept around the product. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product, brand, and communication data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on product and communication goals}. Copy: {Provided by user materials or inferred and designed based on the product}. Product subject: {Specified by user, recognized from reference image, or extracted from product data}. Core message: {Provided by user, or distilled from product selling points, brand positioning, and campaign goals}. Creative direction: {Prioritize user-specified direction; if unspecified, select autonomously based on product attributes and core message, e.g. surrealism, miniature world, colossal product, conceptual metaphor, art installation, fluid world, levitation visual, material realm, editorial advertising, etc.}. Except for factual and core messaging data, design the rest of visual creativity autonomously. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

layouts.name: 角色三视图与头像基准图
layouts.prompt_zh: 排版：角色三视图与头像基准图。画面呈现角色设定基准图，整齐水平排列展示。左侧为脖子以上的头像特写近照（HEADSHOT）；右侧依次为角色的全身正视图（FRONT VIEW）、全身侧视图（SIDE VIEW）、全身背视图（BACK VIEW）。各视图人物保持标准中立直立站姿，视角水平平视，身体比例与高度一致，下方附有简短视图标签。避免：不要歪头，不要拿道具，不要插兜，无倾斜动作。
layouts.prompt_en: Layout: Character Model Sheet & Turnaround Sheet. A horizontal character reference model sheet with views arranged neatly side by side. On the left is a close-up headshot showing the neck and above (HEADSHOT); on the right, sequentially arranged, are the full-body front view (FRONT VIEW), full-body side view (SIDE VIEW), and full-body back view (BACK VIEW). The character maintains a standard neutral upright standing pose at eye level across all views with consistent proportions and height, accompanied by brief view labels underneath. Avoid: no tilted head, no props, no hands in pockets, no dynamic leaning poses.
